edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the relayer address emitted and paid in the meta transaction path.
msg.sender is compared against address(this) to decide whether to spoof the sender from msg.data.
msgSender reads trailing msg.data bytes via assembly to derive the effective caller.
pause checks msgSender derived from msg.sender against PAUSER_ROLE.
unpause checks msgSender derived from msg.sender against PAUSER_ROLE.
Meta transaction execution performs an arbitrary low level self call after consuming the nonce.
User supplied functionSignature is directly used as raw call data for address(this).call.
Nonce mapping is read and updated to prevent meta transaction replay.
Externally supplied userNonce is required to equal the stored nonce and is then incremented with SafeMath add.
Signature verification is required before the call data is executed.
userAddress is used as the expected signer in the verification call.
Signer recovery is performed with ecrecover over the typed message hash.
The assembled MetaTransaction struct is hashed and verified.
mintTo reads currentTokenId, bounds it against TOTAL_SUPPLY and increments the counter.
_safeMint invokes IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on a contract recipient during the mint.
factoryMint loops calling mintTo(_to) for each option unit.
Loop counter i drives the mint iteration bound by _optionId.
_optionId determines how many tokens are minted.
_to is forwarded as the mint recipient.
The canMint modifier invokes factoryCanMint before minting.
factoryCanMint compares _optionId against maxSupply.
Remaining supply is computed as maxSupply - current() from the token counter.
The supplied _optionId is validated against supply limits.
_maxSupply is validated to be strictly greater before being written.
setMaxSupply writes the new maxSupply state value under onlyOwner.
safeTransferFrom calls token.factoryMint, an external state changing call into the token contract.
transferFrom calls token.factoryMint on sale, an external state changing call.
onlyOwnerOrProxy authorization consults isApprovedForProxy before minting.
onlyOwnerOrProxy authorization consults isApprovedForProxy before minting.
isApprovedForProxy reads proxyAddress_ to decide operator approval.
isApprovedForProxy gates approval on the isProxyActive_ flag.
The effective caller from msg.sender is compared against owner/proxy in safeTransferFrom.
The effective caller from msg.sender is compared against owner/proxy in transferFrom.
The external factoryMint call re-enters NFTFactoryERC721.factoryMint which mints via safe mint.
The token state variable supplies the target address of the factoryMint external call.
setNFT repoints the token contract used for all minting calls.
setBaseOptionURI writes the option URI base.
_baseTokenURI parameter is written into baseTokenURI state.
setContractURI writes the collection URI state.
_contractURI parameter is written into collectionURI state.
setBaseTokenURI writes the base token URI state.
transferRoleAdmin grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to an arbitrary address with no two step handover.
restoreOption reads the token contract to query factoryCanMint.
_optionId parameter selects the option that may be restored.
burnInvalidOptions iterates from 1 up to NUM_OPTIONS.
remaining computes TOTAL_SUPPLY - currentTokenId.current().
approve rewrites the proxy address used for approvals, onlyOwner gated.
setApprovalForAll rewrites the proxy address used for approvals, onlyOwner gated.
The onlyFactory modifier compares the caller against the tokenFactory state address.
The resolved sender local variable is returned from msgSender.
